contract: one independently addressable TS188 segment from a preloaded forward-only source
one selected video stream (AVC or HEVC) and one audio stream (AAC, AC-3 or E-AC-3), with stock parsers and no decoders on the reference
every unit retained through the end of the segment; complete Annex B video and ADTS or Dolby audio bytes

each timed and memory operation calls contiguous_feed for every selected AVC or HEVC video unit and folds the complete contiguous payload; any required allocation, copy and release occur inside the operation
video PTS, DTS, random access and raster; application audio clock from each anchor, sample count and rate
video units folded before audio units, then both stream tails; the expected fold is recorded independently per segment
